scope: Actual CQC engine in VM plus controlled DOM; not physical device or browser certification.

checks.name: Empty recordings validate and exports do not expose mutable internal commands
Human commands reproduce full state, actual AI RNG and transient contacts
Complete CPU duels replay until the identical terminal state without imported health
Every one of 346 stable/experimental selections preserves identity in replay
All 52 stages and unsigned seed extremes retain exact setup
Replay seek backward reconstructs RNG, life, resources and object state exactly
Replay speed/chunk size changes presentation only, never simulation outcome
Malformed JSON and oversized UTF-8 payloads fail before a replay is constructed
Version/contract mismatches and unknown identities or stage paths are rejected
Unexpected health/profile fields and prototype pollution keys cannot be imported
Seed, frame count, mask and slot boundaries reject negative/fractional/out-of-range values
Truncated blocks and commands added after terminal time are rejected
Checksum tampering and altered human commands cannot preserve a valid result
CPU files reject hidden manual inputs instead of changing deterministic AI decisions
Replay end is immutable, and invalid seek/count arguments do not advance state
Recording step after terminal completion cannot append extra input frames
Starting or resuming a duel transfers focus from the button to the keyboard arena
Editing form fields or using browser modifier shortcuts never triggers a combat attack
A bad replay import leaves the current running match, setup and playback mode intact
UI imports a valid replay paused, gates human commands and exposes step/seek/exit
Pause and cache restoration keep one loop, no held movement and no phantom attack
An asynchronous import cannot replace a different subject chosen in the meantime
No replay/session action writes storage or sends a campaign result message
R7 profiles/annex/art preserved; only the documented R8 controller/contract successor is allowed
